email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Content Enablement & Acceleration Specialist role at SD Worx. With hands-on experience in content management, SEO and AI-driven automation, I'm drawn to the opportunity to help structure and scale your content ecosystem.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I manage content in WordPress and Shopify, build structured data and llms.txt files, and use AI tools daily to speed up content preparation and audits. I've coordinated content for client websites, including a pharmacists' association site with ~600 member profiles, and I enjoy making content easier to find, reuse and publish.

I'm organised, proactive and comfortable working with colleagues across departments and countries. I'd welcome the chance to support the Content Repository rollout and help teams adopt practical, reusable content approaches.

Thank you for considering my application.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Content Enablement & Acceleration Specialist role at SD Worx. Your focus on making content structured, reusable and easier to publish across markets resonates with how I work: combining content management, SEO and AI tools to help teams get more value from the content they already have.

In my current roles as a freelance SEO and WordPress specialist and as a junior digital marketer at Episto, I manage content in WordPress and Shopify, build structured data and llms.txt files, and use AI tools daily to accelerate research, content preparation and audits. I've coordinated content for client websites, including a pharmacists' association site with around 600 member profile pages, where consistency and structure were essential. I also built and optimised mirook.com with JSON-LD schema and technical SEO/GEO audits, which taught me how structured content and clear governance make reuse and localisation much easier.

What draws me to this role is the hands-on, collaborative nature of the work. I enjoy helping others solve practical content challenges, capturing what works and turning it into repeatable approaches. I'm organised, detail-oriented and comfortable coordinating with colleagues from different departments and countries. I'm curious about AI and automation and how they can simplify content enrichment and publishing, and I'm eager to learn the specific tools and platforms SD Worx uses.

I'd welcome the opportunity to support the Content Repository rollout, help markets adopt common content standards and contribute to a scalable content ecosystem. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Content management in WordPress and Shopify: publishing, updating and structuring pages, blog posts and media for client websites
• AI and automation in daily use: LLMs for research, content preparation and audits; prompt engineering; Python automation
• Structured content and SEO: JSON-LD schema, llms.txt, technical SEO/GEO audits to improve search visibility and content reuse
• Stakeholder coordination: built a consistent layout for ~600 member profile pages for a pharmacists' association site
• Organised and proactive: managing multiple client projects, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console
